evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the false-wake rate is measured over real sources across real elapsed time, not simulated by mutating a local copy
inputs: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10681-10717 (Phase 2 source classes, 12 research modes, claim requirements)
question_or_target: Design and validate the watchlist mechanism the spec requires as a first-class workflow - which change signal per source class (ETag, Last-Modified, content hash, feed entry, release tag), what the false-wake rate is on a 20-source sample over a week, and what a wake actually triggers. Distinct from RES-0006 (measures freshness half-life); this is the event-driven re-check itself.
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: both-states control: a source that genuinely changed must wake the watcher, and a source that only changed its ad markup or timestamp must NOT - a watcher that wakes on both is a poller
title: Standing watchlist: fire a re-check when a watched source changes, without polling everything
